info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Careers Applications Documents-v3-spec
info.description: The Careers Applications Documents Retrieval API provides access to a comprehensive list of documents associated with job applications. This endpoint enables organizations to view and manage application-related documents, ensuring efficient processing and record-keeping. Typical consumers include HR departments and recruitment teams looking to streamline their hiring processes. By utilizing this API, users can enhance their application review workflows and maintain organized documentation.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of application documents.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all documents related to applications in the system. Use it to gather necessary documentation for various application processes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the criteria and parameters for retrieving documents associated with applications. The request may include various filtering options to narrow down the results based on specific attributes or states.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of documents.
